title: 阳光板壁横移
description: 油画小品在窗光中表现低板壁横移，两脚支撑和空旷软垫完整可见。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: Create an original oil-painting illustration of a fictional adult traversing horizontally across a low gently leaning slab beside gym windows. Large mint handholds remain near chest height, and broad footholds form a line just above uninterrupted crash mats. The climber transfers a shoe onto the next foothold with relaxed shoulders and an upright torso, keeping the motion deliberate. Use a wide side-oblique view, warm rectangular sunlight, cream wall texture, and visible impasto strokes. Include the whole clothed figure and a generous empty landing area; small background seating stays well away from it. Maintain plausible adult anatomy. No words, logos, leaps, or exposed outdoor climbing.
